items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, Kenny and Darryl. ... I said, “You need to call Darryl Jones to audition ... And when you do the auditions will be over because they are the best guys.

ctx.x: Now were you responsible for bringing Kenny into the band?
Yeah, Kenny and Darryl. I wasn’t responsible for it, no.
